description: This file is a C++ header defining common data structures, enums, macros, and class interfaces for Miracast services, including notification classes, thread handling, and shared configurations.

classes.name: MiracastServiceNotifier
classes.description: Abstract interface for Miracast service notifications, handling client connection requests, errors, startup requests, and state changes.

classes.name: MiracastPlayerNotifier
classes.description: Abstract interface for Miracast player notifications, reporting player state changes.

classes.name: MiracastThread
classes.description: Class managing thread creation, message passing, and synchronization for Miracast operations.

classes.name: MiracastCommon
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for parsing options and executing system commands.

methods.name: parse_opt_flag
methods.description: Static method to parse option flags from a file name with optional integer check and debug stats.

methods.name: execute_SystemCommand
methods.description: Static method to execute a system command buffer.

methods.name: execute_PopenCommand
methods.description: Static method to execute a command via Popen, expecting specific output and retry logic.
